newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Vitro says Cydsa rumors just rumors.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Vitro says Cydsa rumors just rumors.

text.p: Mexican glass company Vitro SA said that market talk on Wednesday it is planning to sell its stake in chemical firm Cydsa SA is only rumor.

"Our policy is not to comment on market rumors. But I can say it's a recurring rumor. When we decide to sell something, we say so, like we did when we reduced our stake in Serfin and decided to sell Anchor," company spokesman Hiram Peon told Reuters.
Shares of Vitro were up sharply in early afternoon trade on rumors it would sell its 49 percent stake in the chemical and textiles maker. Vitro shares were up 8.19 percent to 18.50 pesos.
Cydsa shares were also up, but had pared their early gains. Cydsa was up 4.76 percent to 22 pesos.
Vitro has been financially strapped and late last year reduced its stake in financial group Serfin and sold its troubled U.S. unit Anchor Glass Corp.
